compiled_state.description:
## Context
The RCA on absurd-zoometric-bobwhite proved that six markerless reconciler echo bodies on three tickets account for the concentrated retained payload. Preparation initially required exactly one live Jira copy per body and correctly refused current reality: each body now has two. Prior cleanup just-preglacial-yeti preserved one preexisting copy per body; reconciler runs 32447039101 and 32447697242 then created and imported six rollout copies. The operator selected coordinated option A: account for Jira and rebar together by disabling the GitHub Actions reconciler, deleting the rollout copies in Jira and the corresponding/non-survivor local history, then re-enabling only after verification.

This ticket remains PREPARATION ONLY. It may add and test a dry-run-default exact-six Jira cleanup surface, produce disposable local rewrite candidates, and document the combined window. It must not disable or enable GitHub Actions, DELETE Jira data, pause writers, publish leases, or update authoritative tickets history. Those actions belong to synonymous-senatorial-cuscus after the ready checkpoint.

## Incident authority and semantic oracle
The incident seed remains the exact tuple of ticket id and body SHA-256:
- 8625-7bea-67db-4cdc: 2a28832f8d7fdb3bbadf4557d163037c31fb6bc32693965c42aa18629ef7de5e, c39cb4843535b2c26790137988010500e53d3dcce3098d315d6ea20f7e00c7e4, eacbefb8d54080f1217c70dc4be4641d20a25b32f88fb42ff5b2a2efb2e64dab
- 9305-b42c-3262-4c58: d429bb0c7d590613d15e2f3f54ed0366143760ca14df0412d14d9bbcaeff6ada, fe854c5c4a276fd5a1a92132c3a9598d3828bfa687d6a23fd75a8afc06e0397b
- e27c-5a20-cd13-43b2: 45f2497fe6298f1172575407f534a63a2dc0825b54c51f29b40b1470f6a73735

At manifest time each group must contain exactly one preexisting survivor and exactly one rollout-created deletion target. The deletion allowlist is 997143, 997144, 997145, 997255, 997256, and 997293, each bound to its expected Jira issue, body hash, author account, and the independently proven rollout provenance. The survivors are 963510, 963511, 963512, 963788, 963789, and 964272. No survivor is selected by age alone. Any extra, missing, moved, edited, differently authored, or differently normalized copy is an abort.

The Git candidate removes every manifest-enumerated non-survivor reconciler COMMENT, including the six Jira deletion identities, and transforms only the enumerated active/retired snapshots plus final .store-compat.json epoch. It preserves the six survivor events, all unrelated paths and bytes, bridge bindings, signatures, topology, authorship, and reduced state except the enumerated echo delta.

## Plan
1. Extend the immutable manifest builder to validate the exact two-live-copy pre-cleanup state and emit one Jira cleanup action plus one survivor per group. Continue to require the clean unfiltered source, exact source tip/ref, complete independently restored bundle, full remote census, complete Jira Cloud v3 pagination, production rich-text normalization, and bridge/source identity checks.
2. Add an incident-specific Jira cleanup tool. Default mode is GET-only dry run. It captures every raw Jira page and a normalized plan off-repository before deletion. Execution requires --execute plus the exact manifest digest. It deletes only the six manifest IDs in canary order REB-2605, REB-1931, REB-1567; logs every attempt append-only; never blindly retries an ambiguous response; re-reads to distinguish landed deletion from failure; and verifies every survivor and every non-target comment remains byte/identity equivalent.
3. Keep the stock-Git history rewriter local-only with no push or remote-update path. It consumes the immutable manifest, removes only enumerated events/snapshot material, changes the final epoch, emits a complete old-to-new commit map, and verifies commit/merge counts, parent topology, author/committer/message identity, per-commit path envelope, replay, snapshots, retained bytes, bridge bytes, refs, and fsck.
4. Update the runbook so one quiet window disables .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml via GitHub Actions, proves state=disabled_manually and no queued/in-progress run or live lease, freezes the exact Git/Jira inputs, executes and verifies the exact-six Jira cleanup, obtains two unchanged production-equivalent dry-run observations while the acting workflow remains disabled, publishes the verified Git candidate with the exact old-tip lease, replaces persistent clones, and only then re-enables the workflow. Any failure keeps the workflow disabled and invokes the documented correction or separately quiesced rollback path.
5. Rehearse the full sequence without shared mutation: current live Jira inventory -> immutable cleanup plan -> simulated post-cleanup inventory -> local history candidate -> whole-store replay/parity -> layered threshold-free measurements -> disposable exact-lease rollback/forward. Preserve failed attempts as evidence.
6. Reuse prior repairs: binary-safe fast-export framing, full-ref backup census, independent bundle restore, epoch refusal, exact leases, persistent-clone replacement, retry-safe deletion logs, and post-read verification. Do not restore the old identical-HEAD-tree oracle, infer pack savings from logical bytes, choose oldest/newest without causal identity, use fixed sleeps as quiescence, or add recurring thresholds, schedules, collectors, ratchets, or workflow gates.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The canonical manifest deterministically binds exactly six ticket/body groups, six rollout-created Jira deletion IDs, and six proven survivors at one frozen source/Jira observation; every identity, pagination, backup, ref, body, author, or copy-count ambiguity refuses before mutation.
- [ ] The Jira cleanup command is GET-only by default; explicit execution is digest-bound, exact-six, canary ordered, append-only logged, ambiguity-safe, resumable, and post-verifies survivor plus non-target parity from a complete pre-delete backup.
- [ ] The local rewrite changes only manifest COMMENT/snapshot material plus the new epoch, removes the Jira-deleted local identities with all other non-survivor echoes, and preserves exactly the six surviving live-Jira-backed events.
- [ ] Active and retired snapshots, source UUIDs, counts, comments, and authorship ledgers transform consistently; full replay, commit-map/topology/identity checks, retained-byte checks, bridge parity, refs, and fsck pass.
- [ ] A complete off-repo bundle is independently restored before any candidate; disposable exact-lease rollback/forward and stale-epoch refusal are proven.
- [ ] Tests prove neither preparation helper can push or update an authoritative Git ref, dry-run cannot DELETE Jira, and every precondition failure occurs before its first external mutation.
- [ ] The runbook directly verifies GitHub Actions disablement and run drainage, exact deployed runtime identity, Jira/Git sequencing, two unchanged dry runs, exact lease, re-clone, non-resurrection, rollback, and re-enable-only-after-verification.
- [ ] Real-store rehearsal records the observed manifest delta, whole-store replay, threshold-free pack/logical/allocated/file/slack/Git/clone measurements, and disposable rollback without mutating Jira or authoritative refs.
- [ ] Focused tests, make lint, make typecheck, and the project test gate pass.
